source.verification_required: Captured source text only from the official DCP Zoning Resolution portal: the section's canonical HTML (node 18107; raw_html_sha256 pinned) and its print/PDF render (cross_check; raw_pdf_sha256 pinned). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the sec-body field--name-body container) and compared block-by-block against the print/PDF text layer. It has NOT been re-read by a second agent, so raw_html_verified stays false and extraction_status stays extracted_draft. Nothing in this record is a rule, a reading of the text for any lot, a derived or computed number, or an eligibility determination; it is the official source text of one ZR section only. Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination (ADR-007: a rule citing it ships under the standing not-professionally-reviewed label with a direct source link; professional review is advisory).

cross_check.pdf_regeneration_note: The print/PDF is regenerated per request (it carries a 'File generated ... on' banner), so raw_pdf_sha256 pins the exact render cross-checked at retrieved_at; a re-fetch would differ in bytes though not in printed text (DB-167).
cross_check.method: The section's print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node/18107 -> print/pdf/node/18107) was retrieved (HTTP 200, application/pdf, raw_pdf_sha256 pinned) and its text layer read with pdftotext -layout. Each block of the HTML-derived verbatim_excerpt was confirmed to appear in the PDF text layer (compared lowercase, straight-quote, whitespace- and hyphen-insensitive; the stored excerpt keeps the HTML's unbroken section-number form where pdftotext wraps a hyphen). The list-item labels in the excerpt are the labels this print/PDF prints in front of each item, confirmed item-by-item. The print/PDF node renders this parent section AND its child sections; every block of this parent-body excerpt was confirmed present within that render, ending before the first child header (23-351).

verbatim_excerpt:
#Inner court# regulations are set forth in Section 23-352 and #outer court# regulations are set forth in Section 23-353. Permitted obstructions in such #courts# are set forth in Section 23-351.

These regulations shall not apply to any #single-# or #two-family# #detached# #residence#.

A corner of a #court# may be cut off between walls of the same #building#, provided that the length of the wall of such cut-off does not exceed seven feet.

The Commissioner of Buildings may approve minor recesses, projections and architectural treatment of the outline of #courts# as long as these variations do not substantially change the depth or width of the #court#.
verbatim_excerpt_composition:
Verbatim blocks of the section body (the sec-body field--name-body container), joined by blank lines, in page order. Each paragraph and each list item is one block; a double

splits a heading line from its paragraph. A list item carries a parenthesised outline label taken from the official PRINT/PDF (the HTML
    markup can restart a list; the labels here were confirmed item-by-item against the print, M3-T008 G1 F1). Defined terms (bold-italic ) are written #term#, exactly as the print/PDF writes them, inner spacing preserved. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; embedded figures are omitted; inline section-reference links are kept as their text; no word was changed. The section number and title are recorded in section_number/section_title and are not repeated in the excerpt.
